sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Physical Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Wicked Eclipse (decreases status ailment resistance by 50, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%, disables Unison gauge filling from Ability, Unison, and Skill effects (Unison gauge fill from taking damage or using Abilities remains unaffected)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 50000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 50000
